ideas.idea: Add groups to robots.txt for other training crawlers (e.g. ClaudeBot) to fully apply the trainingCrawlers: block policy
ideas.why: geo.config.json declares trainingCrawlers: block but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the stated policy is only partly applied.

ideas.idea: Give each blog post its own page/URL linked from the blog list
ideas.why: Blog posts are only titles fetched client-side with no per-post pages, so crawlers have nothing individual to find or quote.

ideas.idea: Write the pricing plans and prices as text on /pricing
ideas.why: The page has a single sentence while its description promises plans for every team size, so more text would help readers and machines.
The docs page is one sentence despite the description 'How to set up Ledger', so adding steps would match the promise.

ideas.idea: Add a canonical to /blog (and a metadata export for it)
ideas.why: /blog has no metadata at all, so it has no title, description or canonical. This extends beyond the known /docs canonical issue.
